title: Kosher Baby Potatoes in Poaching Sauce
description: A fresh and romantic Filipino dish featuring tender baby new potatoes served with a rich poaching sauce.
instructions: Rinse baby new potatoes under cold running water, then pat dry with paper towels.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Add garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant but not browned.
Add broth, salt, black pepper, and lemon juice to the skillet; stir well to combine. Bring mixture to a simmer.
Gently add baby new potatoes into the skillet, ensuring they are evenly coated with the sauce. Reduce heat to low and cover pan.
Bake in preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork but still have some texture.
Remove from oven and let rest briefly before serving warm with fresh parsley sprigs if using.
